children: Bondada Engineering Ltd has signed a memorandum of understanding (MoU) with the Goa Investment Promotion and Facilitation Board (Goa-IPB) for a proposed investment of around Rs 3,000 crore in renewable energy projects in the state.
The MoU, signed on October 30, covers proposed solar energy and biogas projects and is expected to generate more than 700 employment opportunities.

Under the agreement, Goa-IPB will facilitate permissions, registrations, approvals and clearances required for setting up and operationalising the projects. It will also facilitate access to eligible fiscal and non-fiscal incentives under prevailing Goa government policies and regulations.
The MoU is non-binding, with the proposed investment and projects subject to further evaluation, statutory approvals, clearances and other required formalities.
The proposed projects would expand Bondada Group's presence in the renewable energy sector, with the company looking to increase its exposure to solar and biogas projects.
